description: Canonical MCP server definitions for all agent tools (Hermes, Claude Code, Codex). Source of truth — sync.py propagates to each tool's native config format.

playwright.description: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP — browser automation with persistent login sessions.
notes: 12 of 23 tools exposed in Hermes (~2,532 tokens vs 4,577 all-tools).
Claude Code: project-level only (.claude/mcp.json in api-toolkit) — not global. All 23 tools (no per-tool filter in Claude Code's MCP format).
Codex: NOT configured — uses its own browser@openai-bundled + chrome@openai-bundled plugins. No Playwright MCP needed.
browser_evaluate covers: scroll, hover, press_key, resize, select_option, console_messages — all doable via JS.
Persistent profile preserves login sessions across restarts — shared across Hermes and Claude Code.

smartlead.description: Smartlead cold email API — campaign management, webhooks, analytics.
notes: Binary MCP server — already configured in Codex. Not synced to other tools.

supabase.description: Supabase database tools — query, discover, raw SQL, CRUD, RPC, edge functions.
notes: Binary MCP server — already configured in Codex. Not synced to other tools.

legal-mcp.description: US legal research MCP server — 4M+ court opinions (CourtListener), Clio practice management, PACER federal filings. Free alternative to Westlaw/Lexis for case law research and citation grounding.
legal-mcp.install: pip install legal-mcp (in venv) — see https://github.com/Mahender22/legal-mcp
notes: Demo mode works without API keys (CourtListener public data). Set LEGAL_MCP_DEMO=false and add CLIOP_API_KEY / PACER_API_KEY for full features.
Pairs with ~/.claude/skills/legal/ — use legal-mcp to ground contract review clauses in real case law and citations.
Hermes: sync if legal research is needed in Hermes sessions. Token cost ~1,500-2,000 depending on active tools.
Claude Code: project-level only — add to api-toolkit/.claude/mcp.json when working on legal projects.
Codex: not configured — add manually if legal research is needed in Codex sessions.

hermes.tool_filtering: mcp_servers.<name>.tools.include — YAML list of tool names to expose. Others are discovered but not registered.
hermes.browser_toolset: DISABLED — built-in browser toolset disabled in favor of Playwright MCP. Saves ~2,000 tokens of duplicate tool definitions.
hermes.notes: 12 Playwright tools (~2,532 tokens). Built-in browser toolset disabled.

claude_code.tool_filtering: Not supported — all 23 tools load when server is configured. Mitigated by project-level config (only loads when working in api-toolkit).
claude_code.notes: Project-level only in ~/Development/api-toolkit/.claude/mcp.json. All 23 tools (~4,577 tokens) but only when working in this project.

codex.notes: Not configured. Codex uses its own browser@openai-bundled + chrome@openai-bundled plugins. No token overhead from Playwright MCP.
